name: Threaded flange
description: A flat ring whose N holes on the B circle are drilled and tapped after cutting (X marks, tracing), sizes from its own table. From the HVAC Fittings workbench.

fields.label: Sizes from the table
fields.note: From the table: B, E, N (and the slot width or thread) for A from the standard sizes, A80 … A820 (an A between two sizes: as the smaller one). Untick to enter them.

fields.label: B
fields.title: B: diameter the holes lie on (not from the table)

fields.label: E
fields.title: E: ring width (not from the table)

fields.label: N
fields.title: N: number of holes (not from the table)

fields.label: X mark size
fields.note: Only the ring is cut; the holes are drilled and tapped after cutting.

fields.label: Combined
fields.title: The whole ring in one piece

fields.label: Divided (3 × 120°)
fields.title: Three 120° sections, the first cut midway between the top hole and the next
fields.note: Only flanges over A 100 with 3 holes or more are divided.

note: D = A + 2E. The parts' label says the thread's tap drill and the thickness the table recommends.
